How to order

Three easy steps

Choose a suit

Browse the collection and pick the design and colour you like.

Message us on WhatsApp

Tap "Order on WhatsApp" under any suit. The suit name is added to your message automatically.

Confirm your order

Price, delivery and payment details are confirmed with you on WhatsApp.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

How much does a suit cost?

The price of each suit is shared on WhatsApp. Prices will also appear on this website soon.

When will I receive my order?

Delivery time and charges are confirmed on WhatsApp when you place your order.

How do I pay?

The payment method is confirmed on WhatsApp when you order. We never take card details on this website.

Will the colour match the photos?

We show photos of the actual suits. Colours may look slightly different on your screen.
